alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, facing a digital counter on the right that reads 3 saved. Each time a bubble says saved!, this too! or and this! the counter jumps, 12, 47, 98, 212, and the figure stretches tall with happy eyes and a pulse. In the last seconds the text changes from: me saving articles to read later, to: saved: 212. read: 0. Its eyes go wide and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
